notes.title: Mecha Force update Log
notes.content:
Thanks again for offering your thoughtful feedback. We will read ever single thread and ticket.
 
1. LCK Integration Attempt. We will keep polish the LIV sdk for content creators' convenience.
 
2. Ending Sequence Animation Optimizations
 
3.Fixed Crash When Tapping Ultimate Equipment Before Unlock
 
4.Fixed Vulnerability to Ejection from Mech in Qilin Mode
 
5.New Loop Animation Added for Female Protagonist
 
6.In-game iPad Item: Added Japanese Translation & Touch Feedback Adjustment
 
7. Weapon "Fire Tongue": Fixed Life Steal Effect in Upgrades
 
8.Partial Localization Text Adjustments
 
9. Stage Positioning Optimizations for Certain Cutscenes
 
10. Helix Magnetic Field Fluctuation Optimized

Best,
Ming Studio

notes.title: Patch Notes: It's Been 1 Week Since The Launch! We Brought Game Enhancements!
notes.content:
Dear Pilots,
We extend our deepest gratitude to the community for your invaluable feedback. Every report fuels our mission to perfect the game.

Patch Notes

1. Vignette Turn-off Option Added
We can now enable/disable the vignette effect via Settings.

2.UI Interface Optimizations
Fixed UI clipping and misaligned icon issues across multiple interfaces.

3.Text Localization Fixes
Resolved garbled text and missing display issues in localized content.

4.Staging Area Lighting Adjustments
Corrected abnormal lighting effects on deployment platforms in staging zones.

5.Icon Restoration
Reinstated missing icons for the Qiongqi Armor Set.

6.Final Stage Reward Enhancement
Increased clearance rewards for the final stage. Eligible personnel may now perform one HP or ATK upgrade upon completion.

7. Fixed erroneous visual effects during Chapter 1 Boss' missile skill activation.


Ming Studio
